g.title: shellbox
g.text: — agent shell sessions with browser rendering on Databricks
transport + auth verified by Phase 1 probe (#1) · [P1] = measured

g.title: mcp
g.text: shell_create · send · read · list · resize · kill

g.title: db
g.text: session_id, tmux_name, owner_email, cwd, cols/rows, status

g.title: notes
g.text: Sockets die every ~10–18 min on a
wall-clock global event — not per-connection, not periodic, no close
frame. Detect with a client-side liveness timer.
D7 means no frame log exists, so
subscribe(from_seq) repaints from tmux capture-pane. Do not promise
gap-fill semantics the store cannot honour.
HTTP 200 with an HTML login body.
wiped /tmp) · .bashrc rewritten per boot · no cron, no user systemd,
create 1.8 s (warm pool) · start 25 s · stop is async
with a premature success message — poll status. Fresh sandboxes
resolution prefers it and the edge 302s it, so it shadows the grant.

g.title: no1
g.text: no route exists — not a timeout or filter

g.title: no2
g.text: app SP sees only its own; OBO token = scope
a stopped sandbox cannot be revived from the browser

g.title: no3
g.text: dies as clean EOF, indistinguishable from normal end

g.title: no4
g.text: → App would authenticate as creator, not viewer

g.title: no5
g.text: ttyd on root-owned UDS, no HTTPS vhost (TLS mismatch) [P1]
relay: 256 KB cap, Schnorr per event, permanent persistence

g.title: no6
g.text: ✗ dedicated service principal for the tunnel
unnecessary — the sandbox holds its own OAuth grant
